 Meagan Good has the internet losing it and dropping fire emojis after a clip from her appearance at Dillard University hit the TL. The actress popped out for a workout event on campus, and chileeee, Meagan had folks doing double takes as she showed off her physique. Now, fans are giving her tons of flowers, saying she’s been fine their whole life and Jonathan Majors is a lucky man!
 RELATED: Lowkey Love! Jonathan Majors & Meagan Good Reveal Photos From Secret Wedding (VIDEO)  
 Meagan Good Pops Out At Dillard University & Leaves Fans Speechless
 Recently, Meagan Good and Jonathan Majors’ wellness brand, Honor Culture, brought their community run to Dillard University. Clips from the event quickly hit timelines, showing Meagan pulling up in a matching blue workout set featuring a sports bra and leggings. And chileeee, Mrs. Majors looked fit and FOINE as she rocked her curls with a side part. The minute fans caught a glimpse of Megan, they couldn’t help but pop off with reactions. Plenty of folks agreed she’s been fine her whole life and is STILL fine to this day! Peep the video of Meagan Good HERE .
 Mrs. Majors Has Fans Saying She’s Been THAT Girl Her Whole Life
 Once The Shade Room dropped the video of Meagan, Roomies flooded the comment section with reactions. Some fans said she’s aging backward, while others joked that her beauty clearly had the students distracted. See some of the reactions below.

 Instagram user @ roro_inthecity wrote, “ She’s been looking the same age since she was on Cousin Skeeter in the ’90s! The last name Good definitely suits her because she always looks good asf 😭🔥”  
 Instagram user @ only1mollyh wrote, “ The way the men just standing and staring in awe 😍😍😍😍😂😂😂”  
 While Instagram user @ msblingmiami wrote, “ Fine, Fit and in her Forties! Meagan looks incredible! 🔥🔥”  
 Then Instagram user @ tax_baeee wrote, “ Lord if you let me be this small again I promise I won’t mess it up 😩😭” 
 Another Instagram user @ thatssojazz_88 wrote, “ She was looking like a full meal ! And them boys was hungry 😂”  
 Instagram user @ redkafi wrote, “ My body would look like this if my mom didn’t perm my hair.”  
 Then another Instagram user @ mstriece wrote, “ This is definitely THE DEFINITION of Slim Thick 😍🔥🔥🔥”  
 While another Instagram user @ bonitabillionaire wrote, “ This lady been fine my whole life 🥹😍🔥”  
 Instagram user @ chun_bos wrote, “ body is sooo TEAAAA.”  
 Lastly, Instagram user @ beautitul_diasater wrote, “ Just aging backwards yesss Mrs. Majors 🔥” 
 Meagan Leaves Fans Gagging Over Her Iconic 2000s Era
 Meagan Good stays taking over timelines with her flawless face card and fire fit checks! Most recently, she had fans losing it after SiriusXM dropped a fun throwback video highlighting her 2000s era. The clip took fans down memory lane with moments from Meagan’s career. Some folks said 20 years later, NOTHING has changed because Meagan has always been HER and will forever be HER!  Meanwhile, others said she’s truly beautiful — and that’s beautiful with two L’s!
